title: Derived cohomology of upper truncations from CE totals
statement: Let A,B,C be abelian, B,C Grothendieck abelian with derived categories, F:A to B additive, G:B to C additive left exact, and P a CE presentation. For any integer q, any bounded-below complex wrapper Kq whose underlying complex is the upper smart truncation of F(P.J), and any integer n, the cohomology H^n(RG(Kq)) is isomorphic to H^n of the unflipped total of G applied to the horizontal smart truncation of P.I at q. There is no acyclicity hypothesis on F or P.J for G.

source.document: Stacks Project, Homological Algebra and Derived Categories
source.place: Stacks Tag 015X, Remark 13.26.15 (derived truncation computation by filtered injective resolutions); Tag 0156, Lemma 13.20.1 (injective-resolution computation).

proof.text: Use the proved unique CE truncation resolution. Regard its total as a bounded-below complex of injectives, with the displayed quasi-isomorphism from Kq.

Apply the proved acyclic-resolution computation nonempty_homology_rightDerivedFunctorPlus_obj_Q_iso_of_quasiIso. The total terms are injective and therefore G-acyclic. This computes RG(Kq) by termwise G on the truncated total.

The mapped-total isomorphism commutes G with the finite diagonal sums. Compose with totalFlipIso on both sides to retain the original total convention, then apply the homology functor to this complex isomorphism.

theorem cartanEilenberg_derived_truncation_cohomology
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A]
    {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B] [Abelian B] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vB} B]
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] [Abelian C] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vC} C]
    [HasDerivedCategory B] [HasDerivedCategory C]
    (F : A ⥤ B) (G : B ⥤ C) [F.Additive] [G.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits G]
    (P : CartanEilenbergPresentation F) (q : ℤ) (Kq : CochainComplex.Plus B)
    (hKq : Kq.obj = CochainComplex.truncLE
      ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (P.J.cocomplex.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)) q) (n : ℤ) :
    Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor C n).obj
      (G.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj (DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj Kq)) ≅
      (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor G).obj
        (CochainComplex.truncLE P.I q)).total (.up ℤ)).homology n)
